evals.prompt: Build a Gold notebook from the STTM in Output/STTM_DDL_creation/ for OperationalExpenseInvoiceFlattened
evals.expected_output: A .py file in Output/CodeGeneration/ with all 29 sections, Upsert merge strategy, SystemId=101474, ReportingUnitId=107019, source tables fdn_supplier.XTNBusinessTravelFlightReservation and snp_common_dimensions.SCD2Employee

assertions.text: Notebook contains MAGIC %md header cell with project name, purpose, creator, system IDs
Imports are grouped: stdlib then pyspark then pepsico frameworks
No hardcoded values — systemId, reportingUnitId, gold_database_name come from project_params
Transformation SQL uses STTM column mappings with proper aliases
MERGE ON clause includes merge key columns from STTM
Audit framework au.log_audit_data() is called on success and failure paths
No display(), show(), or count() statements in production cells
Notebook ends with notebook_exit_return_parameters or raise Exception

assertions.text: Write logic uses .mode('append') not MERGE INTO
Audit and DQ framework sections are present
